items.title: 夏は七不思議ならぬ“七不穏”で暑さを忘却の彼方へ――涼しくチルアウトできる終末，陰鬱，ディストピアな7つのゲーム
items.summary: 短時間でもしっかりゾワッとできて，遊び終えたあとまで妙な感覚がまとわりつく。日常をじわりと歪ませる作品に静かな終末，生々しいディストピア……暑い夏に涼しくチルアウトできそうな7つの不穏なゲームと，これから訪れる“終わりの予感”を紹介。

zh.title: 夏天不仅有七大奇迹，还有让你忘却炎热的“七大烦恼”——7款末日、阴郁、反乌托邦的游戏，帮助你放松心情。
zh.summary: 即使只是很短的时间，也会让你产生强烈的颤抖，甚至在你玩完之后，你也会有一种奇怪的感觉萦绕在你的周围。慢慢扭曲日常生活的作品，安静的末日，生动的反乌托邦……介绍七款令人不安的游戏，让你在炎热的夏天得到一丝清凉，并感受到末日即将来临。

en.title: Summer is not only the Seven Wonders, but the "Seven Disturbances" that will make you forget about the heat - 7 apocalyptic, gloomy, and dystopian games that will help you chill out.
en.summary: Even if it's only for a short period of time, it gives you a strong shiver, and even after you're done playing, you'll have a strange feeling that sticks around you. Works that slowly distort everyday life, quiet apocalypses, and vivid dystopias... Introducing seven disturbing games that will help you chill out in the hot summer, as well as a sense of the coming end.

zh.title: 带有预览 URL 的自托管开发沙箱“sandboxd”
zh.summary: 沙箱是一种隔离应用程序或系统的开发环境并执行代码的机制，同时防止其影响其他项目。 “sandboxd”已经发布，允许您使用 Docker、Traefik 和 SQLite 轻松构建专门供 AI 代理开发的沙箱平台。阅读更多...

en.title: Self-hosted development sandbox “sandboxd” with preview URL
en.summary: A sandbox is a mechanism that isolates the development environment of an application or system and executes code while preventing it from affecting other projects. ``sandboxd'' has been released that allows you to easily build a sandbox platform specialized for development by AI agents using Docker, Traefik, and SQLite. read more...

items.title: Xが「クリエイター収益分配」を終了し「オリジナルコンテンツ報酬プログラム」開始へ
items.summary: 2023年7月から展開されてきたXの「クリエイター収益分配(Revenue Sharing)」が終了し、入れ替わりに「オリジナルコンテンツ報酬プログラム(Original Content Rewards Program)」が始まることが明らかになりました。すでに「クリエイター収益配分」への新規登録は停止されていて、参加者の収益獲得最終日は2026年9月7日分に設定されています。続きを読む...

zh.title: X结束“创作者收益分成”，启动“原创内容奖励计划”

en.title: X ends “creator revenue sharing” and starts “original content reward program”
en.summary: It has been revealed that X's ``Revenue Sharing'', which has been in place since July 2023, will end and the ``Original Content Rewards Program'' will begin in its place. New registrations for "Creator Revenue Distribution" have already been suspended, and the last day for participants to earn revenue is set for September 7, 2026. read more...

items.title: 有料購読が必要な学術論文を見る際に自動的に合法的なオープンアクセス論文を収録したデータベースをチェックして無料で読めるかどうかがわかる「Unpaywall」

en.title: When viewing academic papers that require a paid subscription, "Unpaywall" automatically checks the database containing legal open access papers and tells you whether you can read them for free.
en.summary: "Unpaywall" is a browser extension that uses a database search to check whether the academic paper you are looking for is provided open access, and if it is available for free subscription, displays a link button. read more...
